metadata.title: Supermassive black hole growth from stellar binary encounters

notes: No eligible stars identified. The paper discusses hypervelocity stars only generically (e.g., T:p1-b9) and an unnamed group of nine LMC-linked B-type HVSs (T:p7-b6), without individual star names or Gaia identifiers and without an explicit determination that any specific star is presently unbound from the Milky Way. Such labels and proposed origins alone do not establish candidacy under the stated rules.
